workouts.title: Easy Swim Technique
workouts.description: Focus on smooth breathing and relaxing your arms in the water to build basic freestyle efficiency.

workouts.title: Complete Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest completely today to let your body absorb yesterday's swimming session and recover fresh.

workouts.title: Steady Spin
workouts.description: Ride at a smooth, conversational pace to get used to turning the pedals and building base leg endurance.

workouts.title: Active Recovery Rest
workouts.description: Take a rest day today, focusing on drinking plenty of water and getting a good night of sleep.

workouts.title: Easy Jog

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy your rest day today and prepare mentally and physically for your weekend brick workout.

workouts.title: Beginner Brick Workout

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Give your muscles a chance to rest and repair after your opening swim session of the week.

workouts.title: Moderate Cycling
workouts.description: Pedal at a comfortably hard pace to build leg strength and improve your overall cycling aerobic fitness.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a complete day off from structured training to keep your energy high for the upcoming run.

workouts.title: Run Intervals
workouts.description: Alternate between fast running segments and walking to safely introduce speed and build heart health.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest and recover after yesterday's running intervals to prevent any unnecessary fatigue.

workouts.title: Weekend Brick

workouts.title: Technique Swim

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Bike Intervals

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a well-deserved rest day to let your legs recover completely from the hard bike session.

workouts.title: Steady Run
workouts.description: Maintain a steady and comfortable running pace for the entire duration to build good aerobic stamina.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Relax and recover today, ensuring you eat nutritious foods to fuel your upcoming weekend workout.

workouts.title: Recovery Swim

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take another easy rest day to let your mind and body completely reset for the next training block.

workouts.title: Short Easy Run

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest completely today and enjoy feeling refreshed for the start of the second half of the plan.

workouts.title: Weekend Rest
workouts.description: Extra rest day to conclude your recovery week nicely before ramping things up again.

workouts.title: Distance Swim
workouts.description: Swim continuously for longer intervals to build the stamina needed for the swim leg of your race.

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Endurance Bike
workouts.description: Ride at a steady, moderate tempo to increase your aerobic engine and leg strength.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day to recover from the bike ride and prepare for tomorrow's run.

workouts.title: Interval Run
workouts.description: Run moderate speed intervals to improve your running economy and cardiovascular fitness.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest up and relax today so your legs are fresh for the weekend brick session.

workouts.title: Speed Swim

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day to let your shoulders and core recover from the swimming workout.

workouts.title: Hill Climb Bike

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Longer Steady Run

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Endurance Brick

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest up and relax today, keeping your energy levels high for the upcoming bike session.

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.description: Run at a steady, strong pace to get used to how your body will feel during the end of the race.

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Peak Brick Workout

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest completely today and enjoy knowing you have completed a fantastic training block.

workouts.title: Final Easy Spin

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day today, focusing on light stretching and feeling good in your body.

workouts.title: Final Easy Jog
workouts.description: A short, easy jog with a few strides to keep your running mechanics feeling fresh and smooth.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and relax, letting your body store up peak energy for your final workout.

workouts.title: Celebration Brick
workouts.description: A short and fun transition workout to celebrate all the hard work you put into this training plan.
